title: This portfolio
tagline: A static Astro site that tests itself on every push: Playwright across five browsers, axe, visual regression and Lighthouse budgets.
problem: A portfolio that claims test-automation expertise should prove it in its own repository, not just describe it.
built: An Astro and Tailwind CSS site with every piece of content in typed data collections, a dark and light theme that never flashes, and a Playwright suite on the Page Object Model: end-to-end, data-integrity, accessibility, keyboard and visual-regression tests on desktop Chromium, Firefox and WebKit plus mobile Chrome and Safari. CI gates every deploy on lint, type checks, the suite and Lighthouse budgets, then publishes a summary of that run to the page itself.
highlights: Zero client JavaScript apart from the theme toggle and the filters
Content collections with Zod schemas: adding a project or certificate never touches markup
Deploys only when lint, types, tests and Lighthouse budgets all pass
The status panel at the top of the page is written by the run that deployed it
testing: Playwright with page objects and custom fixtures on five browser projects, axe-core in both themes, keyboard-only navigation, visual baselines from Playwright's Docker image, a data-integrity suite that renders every collection entry, and Lighthouse CI budgets of 95 or better in every category.
